<thought>Since searching with “alkyl halide” and “aliphatic hydroxyls” returned no templates, I will broaden the functional‑group criteria. The forward reaction breaks an aliphatic C‑O bond and forms a C‑X bond, so in retrosynthesis the template should break a halide bond and form an aliphatic hydroxyl. I will search using the broader group “halide” for the broken bond and keep “aliphatic hydroxyls” for the formed group on the halogenated product SMILES.</thought>
